data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Abana', which means 'to serve'. Labbaanah is a beautiful name for a girl, symbolizing devotion and dedication to Allah. The name Labbaanah carries the meaning “A servant or devotee” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Labbaanah usually hope their child will grow to embody a servant or devotee and live with faith, good character and purpose.
